thread.title: Nearly 50 trades in Apple's stock went through at the $1 trillion market-cap level - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Nearly 50 trades in Apple's stock went through at the $1 trillion market-cap level - MarketWatch
text:
As Apple Inc.'s stock AAPL, +3.22% pulls back from its intraday high of $207.05, which put the technology giant on track for a $1 trillion market capitalization, investors who bought at that price shouldn't feel too lonely. During a seven-second span, from 11:48:04 ET to 11:48:11, 49 trades went through at $207.05, for total volume of about 6,095 shares. At 11:48:04, about 3,400 shares over 33 trades went through at $207.05. At that price, the stock was up $5.55, or 2.75%, and Apple would have a market cap of $1.002 trillion. The stock has slipped to be up just 2.5% at $206.58, for a market cap of $997.7 billion. Apple is still well ahead of 2nd-place Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, +1.78% which currently has a market cap of $885.7 billion. Apple's stock has now run up 22% year to date, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.02% has gained 2.2%.
